en.bookingConditions.title: Booking Conditions
en.bookingConditions.intro: Please review these booking conditions carefully before making a reservation.
en.bookingConditions.cancellation.title: 1. Cancellation Policy
en.bookingConditions.cancellation.free: Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival (14:00).
en.bookingConditions.cancellation.late: From 7 days before arrival, a cancellation fee of 20% of the booking price applies.
en.bookingConditions.payment.title: 2. Payment Methods
en.bookingConditions.payment.methods: Payments can be made via Stripe or PayPal.
en.bookingConditions.deposit.title: 3. Deposit & Payment Rules
en.bookingConditions.deposit.first: 20% deposit at the time of booking.
en.bookingConditions.deposit.second: 80% remaining balance due no later than 7 days before arrival.
en.bookingConditions.cleaning.title: 4. Cleaning Fee
en.bookingConditions.cleaning.text: The cleaning fee is included in the total price.
en.bookingConditions.cityTax.title: 5. City Tax
en.bookingConditions.cityTax.text: The city tax is included in the total price.
en.bookingConditions.checkin.title: 6. Check-in & Check-out

en.apartments.cosy_couple_nest.descripti: A cozy double bed for couples or solo travelers.
en.apartments.cosy_couple_nest.long_desc:
Welcome to the Cosy Couple Nest, your cozy retreat in the heart of Vienna. This charming apartment offers a comfortable double bed, ideal for couples or solo travelers who value peace and comfort.

The living area invites you to relax with a modern TV – perfect for movie nights or unwinding after an exciting day. Thanks to the fast, free WiFi, you stay connected at all times, whether for work or leisure.

The fully equipped kitchen includes everything you need for self-catering: fridge, kettle, microwave, cooking facilities, and plenty of dishes. You can easily prepare your favorite meals.

The modern bathroom with shower ensures a refreshing start to the day or relaxing moments in the evening.

The Cosy Couple Nest: small, charming, and perfect for your stay in Vienna.
en.apartments.cosy_couple_nest.name: Cosy Couple Nest
en.apartments.duo_deluxe_studio.descript: A modern double bed for couples or solo travelers.
en.apartments.duo_deluxe_studio.long_des:
Welcome to the Duo Deluxe Studio – your stylish home away from home in Vienna. This modern studio offers a comfortable double bed, ideal for couples or solo travelers who appreciate design and functionality.

The living area is equipped with a high-quality TV, allowing you to enjoy relaxing evenings with your favorite movies or series. The fast, free WiFi ensures you stay perfectly connected at all times.

The well-equipped kitchen includes everything you need for self-catering: fridge, kettle, microwave, cooking facilities, and plenty of dishes. You can prepare your meals just the way you like them.

The modern bathroom with shower provides comfort and refreshment after a long day in the city.

The Duo Deluxe Studio: stylish, modern, and perfect for your stay in Vienna.
en.apartments.duo_deluxe_studio.name: Duo Deluxe Studio

en.apartments.twin_harmony_suite.descrip: Two comfortable single beds for friends or colleagues.
en.apartments.twin_harmony_suite.long_de:
Welcome to the Twin Harmony Suite – perfect for friends, colleagues, or solo travelers who prefer separate beds. The two cozy single beds offer comfort and flexibility.

The living area features a modern TV and invites you to relax. Fast WiFi keeps you connected.

The kitchen includes everything you need: refrigerator, kettle, microwave, stove, and dishes.

The bathroom with shower provides comfort and refreshment.

The Twin Harmony Suite: flexible, comfortable, and ideal for your stay in Vienna.
